newsitem.title: USA: PharmaPrint files IND for herbal drug.
newsitem.headline: PharmaPrint files IND for herbal drug.

text.p: PharmaPrint Inc said Tuesday that it has submitted its first investigational new drug (IND) application with the FDA, for a drug, derived from the saw palmetto berry, which is intended to relieve symptoms associated with benign prostate enlargement.
PharmaPrint said it hopes to begin Phase II clinical trials in the United States in 30 to 60 days at four American medical centers.

The company also said its goal is to submit about one IND per quarter during the next three years, all of which will employ its proprietary technology to standardize multimolecule herbal medicines for clinical testing, FDA review and third-party reimbursement.
PharmaPrint said its next IND, targeted for later in 1997, involves a drug derived from St. John's wort to address depression.
PharmaPrint is a developer and manufacturer of patented pharmaceuticals derived from herbal products.
